clips.title: The story
paras: In the Barrens, an aspiring shaman begins the second trial in the search for communion with fire. Kranal Fiss sends the initiate across the Southfury River to a secluded mountaintop shrine in Durotar, carrying the unlit Torch of the Dormant Flame.

Kranal Fiss entrusts the shaman with the Torch of the Dormant Flame. Raw mystical strength alone cannot meet fire’s demands; the trial calls for temperance, focus, and respect. The torch is both ritual instrument and proof to the shrine’s keeper that the bearer has been judged ready to attempt the trial.

The shrine lies across the Southfury River, among Durotar’s southern crags. A weathered stone carved with a fire rune marks an obscure path that climbs toward one of the region’s highest peaks. At the summit, the Shrine of the Dormant Flame is watched by Telf Joolam, a troll hermit. He turns away curious travelers and treasure hunters, keeping the sacred brazier from ordinary eyes until a petitioner arrives with the unlit torch.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You are powerful enough to wield the totem of fire, but that does not mean you are ready.

Along the Southfury River in Durotar, before the Great Sea, lies a hidden trail to one of the highest peaks in the land. Find your way to the top and you shall find one of our holy shrines watched over by Telf Joolam--the Shrine of the Dormant Flame.
Take this torch to him--it marks that you attempt to tame fire. Return it to me aflame by the brazier at the shrine and I will see you are given the totem of fire.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetin's, friend. You've found yourself at the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. Only those knowledgeable enough in the shamanistic arts will ever learn the secrets of this place and the power it holds. I'm sorry you made the trip all this way, only to be turned back now--the journey up here is far from safe after all--but I am the keeper of the shrine, and I cannot allow just anyone to wander around here.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, my mistake, friend. I apologize. I did not realize you possessed the Torch. I am pleased to make your acquaintance.

Many adventurers find their way here while looking for lost treasure or the promise of mystical creatures to slay, only to be turned away from a seemingly empty shrine. But we know the truth, do we not, friend?
This shrine holds a greater secret from the mundane members of the Horde. To us, it is sacred.
